fees.what: Work permit application fee, per form (as stated for the ASEAN skilled-labour procedure)
Work permit valid up to 3 months
Work permit valid over 3 up to 6 months
Work permit valid over 6 months up to 1 year

sources.title: Thailand.go.th (Digital Government Development Agency), Procedure for Obtaining a Work Permit for Foreigners under ASEAN Free Skilled Labor Mobility (updated 17 June 2023)
sources.said: Application fee is 100 Baht per form. Work permit fee: Work permit valid for no more than 3 months is 750 Baht per permit. Work permit valid for more than 3 months but not exceeding 6 months is 1,500 Baht per permit. Work permit valid for more than 6 months but not exceeding 1 year is 3,000 Baht per permit. For a permit that is valid for more than 1 year, the fee increases according to the rates in items 1), 2), or 3). Service Channels for obtaining a work permit for foreigners under ASEAN Free Skilled Labor Mobility: Foreign Labor Management Office, Department of Employment

sources.title: Envoy Global, Thailand: Updates for the Urgent Work Permit Category
sources.said: Item (13) Work supported by government agencies: (a) Mega event organization or international festival (b) International music festival or concert
